risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (448.16), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and imminent CPI event create severely unfavourable macro conditions for equities despite distant earnings.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term moving average structure (EMA 50/200, SMA 50/200) remains bullish with supertrend confirmation, and extreme fear sentiment (14/100) presents classic contrarian opportunity near support at 33.9969.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis at 448.16, rising dollar, flat yield curve), deteriorating short-term momentum (dual MACD bearish crossovers, RSI 34 without confirmation, price below all key short-term MAs), three black crows pattern, and zero fundamental/smart money support make this a high-risk entry in an unfavourable environment.
